Jx.bar_b_note: The bulky bear silhouette and its scale against the trainer hold up, but the busy yellow-speckle-on-brown fur turns into one muddy mid-tone at small size, with no rim light to separate it.

Le.bar_b_note: The white-fleece, dark-horn ram silhouette is the owner's own style-bar creature and reads like a Palworld pal, though in B the horns stretch into long black tubes in faint mid and faint end, which sinks that side.

Qd.bar_b_note: A's naturalistic furry boar comes close but its blotchy yellow pattern is noisy and it barely reaches the trainer's height, and B's smooth clay-toy pig with a sit-up faint end reads like a placeholder, not a shipping creature.

Cj.bar_b_note: B's larger, fully wrapped recipe text and the deep blue-grey panel read well, but the plain text-and-keycap hints with no teal interaction accent or controller-glyph buttons, over a murky dark scene, stop it short of Palworld-level UI finish.

Hs.bar_b_note: A warm, expressive grandfather villager with a clear face and eyes and an earthy green-and-brown outfit that suits the cozy Meadows settlement, though its rounded cartoon face sits a little softer than the stylised-realism creatures.

Hf.bar_b_note: Same bear as Jx: strong mass and scale, but the speckled dark fur muddies the value read, and in B the flame stays lit on the fainted body.

Wp.bar_b_note: The gold-and-moss gecko with its leafy crest has an appealing, high-contrast silhouette and a visible face, which carries it, though it is low-slung and only about the trainer's height.

Rw.bar_b_note: The quills and pink snout and feet give a clear identity, but even B's lifted violet-grey fur stays a low-value mass with little rim light, so at small size the body reads as a dark blob next to Palworld's bright pals.

top_changes.change: Creature material value pass: lift fur albedo on dark or speckled coats (Rw, the Jx/Hf bear, Qd A boar), calm the noisy yellow blotch patterns into readable markings, and add a rim or fresnel light term so bodies separate from the stage at 30% size.

Hurt/faint animation cleanup: put out the aspect flame on faint (Jx A, Hf B), keep the hit-react flinch grounded (Wp B), fix the horn skinning that stretches the horns into tubes during faint (Le B), and replace the Qd B sit-up faint end with a proper slump.

Replace the smooth clay-toy boar (Qd B) with a naturalistic fur-and-moss model that matches the Mudsnout colour board and the owner's creature style bar, and scale low creatures (Qd, Wp) so they stand clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer.
